## Objective
- Update the existing browser NFL game with a working play clock, selectable real NFL teams with matching end-zone labels, and clear rules for players.

## Requirements
- Make the play clock functional.
- Let players choose real NFL teams and show the selected teams in the scoreboard and end zones.
- Explain the game rules to players.

- Added selectors for all 32 NFL teams; selecting a team starts a new game and avoids duplicate matchups.
- The 25-second play clock counts down while the user has possession; expiration applies a five-yard delay-of-game penalty.
- Expanded the How to Play dialog to explain downs, scoring, dice, play clock, and team selection.
